title: Delete broken migrations and generate clean initial migration
description:
Delete all existing migration files in alembic/versions and generate a new clean initial migration. Before editing, inspect: current migration files and Alembic configuration.

1. Delete everything in alembic/versions/ except __init__.py
2. Run `alembic revision --autogenerate -m 'Initial clean migration'`
acceptance_criteria: alembic/versions directory contains only __init__.py and one migration file
New migration file contains table definitions matching current models
